correctness.rationale: For any exchangeable nonvoter set, voter v loses weight exactly when its entire default orbit O_v abstains, giving exact E loss = Σ_v a_|O_v|. Every directed functional component of a nearest-neighbor path is an interval with one self-loop or reciprocal edge. For monotone a_s, concave partial sums move each component cycle to an endpoint; the reciprocal-pair cost h(m)=2a₂+Σ_{s=3}^m a_s is no larger than the self-loop cost. h is subadditive, hence merging components cannot worsen the optimum. One terminal pair realizes the global lower bound. For independent q in (0,1), the relevant strict inequalities force only the two endpoints. Verified all fixed-count exchangeable models for all 1456 allowed profiles at n=2..7 and the iid unique minima; finite enumeration does not substitute for the arbitrary-n proof.
